About the Scholarship

Warwick's top fully funded PhD awards, allocated annually via a combined postgraduate research scholarship competition.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: Chancellor's Scholarships (Warwick Flagship Scheme)
HostUniversity of Warwick
LocationCoventry, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded, stipend provided, tuition covered
StipendFull tuition fees + living stipend at UKRI rate + Research Training & Support Grant (up to £5,000)
Application Deadline10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT; course application 7 December; references 21 December
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Current Competition Dates

For autumn 2027 entry, submit the course application by 7 December 2026, the scholarship application by 10 December and references by 21 December. All three close at 16:59 GMT. Research training grants are separate from the living stipend.

Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: Chancellor's Scholarships
  • Host Institution: University of Warwick
  • Study Level: PhD / MPhil-PhD
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Coverage: Full tuition fees + living stipend at UKRI rate + Research Training & Support Grant (up to £5,000)
  • Duration: Up to 3.5 years
  • Eligibility: Home and International PhD applicants
  • Application Deadline: 10 December 2026, 16:59 GMT (for 2027/28 entry)

Programme Description

The Chancellor's Scholarships are Warwick's top fully funded PhD awards, allocated annually via a combined postgraduate research scholarship competition. One application automatically considers you for multiple schemes including Chancellor's Scholarships, AHRC Doctoral Scholarships, Doctoral Access Scholarships, Monash–Warwick Alliance Joint Scholarships, and CSC–Warwick Joint Scholarships.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://warwick.ac.uk/services/dc/schols_fund/applicants/competitions/

Source: warwick.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 10 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Warwick

University of Warwick is a public research university near Coventry, England, and a Russell Group member. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, business, economics, humanities and social sciences. Its campus-based academic community connects teaching with research, professional development and collaboration with industry and international university partners.

Official website: https://warwick.ac.uk/

How to Apply

  1. Apply to a PhD/EngD/MPhil-PhD programme at Warwick
  2. Submit the Postgraduate Research Scholarship Application by the deadline
  3. You will be considered for all eligible schemes
